diagram_math_checks.result: Q=[0,1]x[0,2], a(y)=y(2-y)/6, C={(x,y):0<=y<=2,a(y)<=x<=a(y)+1}. F:Q->C is F(s,y)=(s+a(y),y), with inverse Phi(x,y)=(x-a(y),y); this is exactly step 6.2 for bounding graphs a,a+1. The map is analytic with determinant 1 and preserves orientation. C is a compact closure of a connected open region with analytic side arcs and horizontal wall arcs.

Boundary vertices of Q in positive cyclic order are (0,0),(2/3,0),(1,0),(1,1),(1,2),(1/3,2),(0,2),(0,1), with q=(1/2,1). F fixes wall marks since a(0)=a(2)=0, maps ell to (1/6,1), r to (7/6,1), and q to (2/3,1). All nine vertex dots are explicit coordinates, without slash-delimited loop ambiguity.

diagram_math_checks.check: Every edge and every face boundary
diagram_math_checks.result: There are eight boundary edges between successive listed boundary vertices and eight spokes q to those vertices, with the two horizontal spokes drawn together. The six nonhorizontal band spokes are explicitly plotted as x=a(y)+s(y), where s(y) on the lower interval is y/2,1-y/2,2/3-y/6 and on the upper interval is 1-y/2,y/2,2/3-y/6. Substitution at y=0,1,2 verifies all endpoints. The band side arcs x=a(y),x=1+a(y) and both explicit horizontal closing segments complete the outer boundary. Each of the eight face boundaries is (q,b_i,b_{i+1},q), and its image is the corresponding curvilinear triangle; no closing edge is implicit in a named-node cycle.

diagram_math_checks.check: Incidences and nonoverlap justified by the actual map
diagram_math_checks.result: A local Node calculation counted V=9,E=16,F=8, boundary-vertex degree 3 and interior degree 8; every rectangle face had positive signed area (1/3,1/6,1/4,1/4,1/3,1/6,1/4,1/4), total area 2. Q is convex and these ordered fan triangles cover Q face to face. The explicit homeomorphism F transports these incidences and disjoint interiors to C, as in step 7.1. Distinct arcs remain ordered by their s-values at each height; the figure does not claim that their images are straight.

For each positively ordered face (q,b_i,b_{i+1}), the internal spoke q->b_i has sign +1 in that face and -1 in the preceding face. All eight spokes therefore cancel in the sum of face contours, leaving bottom rightwards, right graph upwards, top leftwards and left graph downwards. F has positive Jacobian determinant 1, so this sign convention survives the pullback, exactly matching the Statement.

The illustration is a specific nonpinched band from steps 6.2 and 7.1, not a claim that every R has one band or no pinches. Step 8.1 remains the separate pinched-band construction. No P-avoidance configuration is asserted. Every original proof step is unchanged and the rigorous proof remains independent of the figure.
